test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

People all over the world are concerned about the human right to live with ______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dignity**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• People all over the world are concerned about the human right to live with being worth of honor and respect.
 
• **Dignity**: the state or quality of being worthy of honor or respect.
 
 
• ​**For eg.-** That speech was full of **dignity** and greatness as Napoleon understood it.
 
 
 
• We will thus use the word **dignity** to fill in the blank.
 
• Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
